items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: So when I come back to Jackson, I got a very good friend in Jackson, Joe White.

ctx.x: now did you ever have to substitute on any other instruments like what did you get one set off or a number off now and then so you could go and eat or anything well well no yes what no I had a racket it would cost me a nickel I'd break a straight take two hours to fix it that was the only racket I've heard sometimes like they take turns about to keep the drummer going all the time and one other guy would go and take the drummer's place and he could go out

well Bill I said this I love music and if I had my life to live over again I wouldn't be nothing else but a musician but not a badger player I'd be a trumpet player this time I better be you see cause everybody the bad you see I read in a little book kid Thomas with his enormous power he can play for 14 hours without stopping yeah but he don't play seven notes in them 14 hours either he said…

I was going to ask a little bit more. Wait a minute. Can you tell us a little about Wilhelmina Barth? Because I never did get to hear her. I know she was a good pianist. What style did she play? What kind of piano?
